title: WPP Enterprise Solutions Named a Strong Performer in Customer Experience Strategy Consulting Services, Q4 2026 Evaluation by Independent Research Firm
summary: WPP Enterprise Solutions Named a Strong Performer in Customer Experience Strategy Consulting Services, Q4 2026 Evaluation by Independent Research Firm
body_markdown:
WPP announced today that WPP Enterprise Solutions has been named a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™: Customer Experience Strategy Consulting Services, Q4 2026, receiving the highest scores possible in the proprietary data integration capabilities, CX vision development and talent strategy criteria.


Customer experience practice connects strategy and execution, combining experience design, technology, data and operations to help clients create connected experiences that drive measurable business outcomes.


**Ben Geheb, Global CX Lead, WPP Enterprise Solutions, said:** “Customers are engaging across more channels than ever, while becoming harder to reach and retain. At the same time, AI is fundamentally changing how people discover, evaluate and buy. Our role is to help clients make sense of that complexity and create connected experiences that earn attention, build trust and drive growth. We’re proud for the work our teams are doing to help clients navigate that change.”


In its assessment of customer feedback, the Forrester report noted: “Customers praised WPP Enterprise Solutions’ client care and advice, with one noting that they felt it genuinely cared about their success.”


**Adam Gerhart, Global Chief Client Officer, WPP, said:** “Our clients’ success is at the heart of how we work, so it is particularly meaningful for us to see the trust they place in our teams and the value of our strategic advice reflected in their feedback. Building strong, long-term partnerships gives us the understanding we need to help brands create customer experiences that deliver meaningful outcomes for our clients’ businesses and their customers over the long term.”


This recognition adds to WPP Enterprise Solutions’ recent designation as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Adobe Professional Services 2026 Vendor Assessment and as a Strong Performer in The Forrester Wave™: Loyalty Services, Q4 2026, in which WPP received the highest possible scores in criteria including customer experience design, customer data privacy and partner ecosystem.


Subscribers to Forrester can access the complete **Customer Experience Strategy Consulting Services** report[here](https://www.forrester.com/report/RES204372) .
